title: Eligibility List Released for U-13 National Championships
indian_angle: This list is crucial for young Indian badminton players aspiring to compete in a major national championship.
summary: The eligibility list for the Yonex-Sunrise 38th Sub Junior (U-13) National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled for December 9-12 in Jalandhar, has been officially released.

title: BAI Elections Set for December 26 in Guwahati
indian_angle: The upcoming elections will determine the leadership of the Badminton Association of India, impacting the sport's direction in the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced that its forthcoming elections will be held on December 26, 2026, in Guwahati.

title: Venue Change Announced for Mini National Championships
indian_angle: This update is important for participants and organizers of a national championship for young Indian badminton talent.
summary: A circular has confirmed a change of venue for the Yonex-Sunrise 5th Mini National Badminton Championships 2026, which will now be held in Raipur from November 24th to 27th.

title: Senior National Badminton Championships Confirmed for Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: This major national event will feature India's top senior badminton players competing for national titles in Odisha.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 are scheduled to take place in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17th to 24th.

title: 49th Junior National Badminton Championships Underway in Sikkim
indian_angle: This ongoing championship in Sikkim is a key platform for India's promising junior badminton players to showcase their skills.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026 are currently being held in Sikkim from November 14th to 21st, following the release of the eligibility list on October 23rd.
